judge_requirements: Actual joint video and audio input with source BGM/SFX; anonymized candidate and no solver identity/reasoning or other dimension scores. Waveform/frame measurements assist timing; model judgment alone is not millisecond-accurate.
limitations: Linear convenience mapping, not expert-calibrated perceptual quality.
Dynamic checks selected after inspecting this output; total is a diagnostic score under this revision, not a previously frozen benchmark result.
Image appearance metrics also respond to geometric and shading differences; they do not isolate texture quality.
score_interpretation: Current accepted score using the user-confirmed Gemini 4 Neon v3 audiovisual evaluation. Earlier model runs and audit records are retained separately.
judge_model_source: User reports this v3 evaluation was performed with Gemini 4 Neon and explicitly accepts the supplied result.
